reviews.author: Sona Suzanne
reviews.text: A2B is undoubtedly one of the preferred breakfast stops for many. The airport road one was neat and bathrooms were ok. Food was at par. Service needs to be handled better. The lady cleaning the bathroom was pretty rude saying don't wash hands in the restroom area. I told her to speak a bit more politely as I wasnot aware that the tap is leaking.

details.parking: The restaurant,  for the capacity that it runs with, doesn't have sufficient parking space. The security guard was a bit rude to all of us... esp bikers. I don't understand why bikers are discriminated against while a car with a single person gets better respect. What we eat and pay mostly is the same i believe. It was a let down.
details.kid_friendliness: It's an ok place to bring kids if they like South Indian breakfast
details.wheelchair_accessibility: A bit tough for a wheelchair...there is a flight of stairs at the entrance.

reviews.author: hemanth bhat
reviews.text: Food was good and tasty at A2B. But the dining experience could be improved — the AC was not working, the wash area tap was broken, and the toilet was not clean. Hope the management fixes these issues soon.

reviews.author: Alby
reviews.text: Sambar was not up to the mark and vada received was very cold at the cost of 60..Toilets were not cleaned at least for a year time,...Only dosa up to the mark and please check my photos for your reference..A2B everywhere in Tamilnadu assure clean toilets but here it's like a public toilet...once you change it will be happy to give a positive review

reviews.author: Veera Ragavan
reviews.text:
First come first, we went for food and it was not up to the A2B standard. Easily available ghee dosa was very bad and kara chutney was very sweet.

Half of the menu was not available due to LPG shortage which is acceptable.

Washroom was smelling very bad.

reviews.text: The service was very good by Manoranjan. He is very polite. The ambiance was a little hot. Improve in cleanliness of the sitting area lots of flies and food particles. The washroom was also very dirty and smelly.

reviews.author: anshika
reviews.text: Yesterday we went there for lunch, we had to look for people if we wanted something. We have been waiving at the staffs but they were hardly paying attention to their customers. Once they serve your order, they forgot that you are sitting. Customer may need something more or would like to order more. But they just want us to finish and go. They don't pay attention to their customers at all, when we told one of the lady staffs when she came with bill, she didn't even apologise or said that anything? Is this the way you people treat your customers? So it doesn't matter that u lose one customer but I will tell more people about your customer service! Not coming back again! We pay for food n service and they were hardly good at both! 👎🏻also a lot of flies there.. irritation while eating, dirty washroom.
